name: 4764-longdecode-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite, the BASE repo (it ships no chat template) in bf16. ~30 GB of safetensors, ungated, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, SM90, one a3 node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One card, one node.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM: 27 layers, hidden 2048, 16 attention heads, MLA (kv_lora_rank 512, v_head_dim 128), MoE 64 routed + 2 shared, top-6. 15.7B total / 2.4B active, bf16. The rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16, warmup the first 15%, bounded at 288 requests (18 waves of 16) with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn over /v1/completions, no prefix structure: 4000 prompt tokens in and 1000 generated out, both fixed (stdev 0), with ignore_eos true and temperature 0.0 in backend.extras.body so every request generates exactly 1000 tokens.
purpose: A long-form report writer expanding 4000-token briefs into 1000-token drafts for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# sglang, in `sglang serve` CLI form: one `key: value` per line. The reader takes the file line by
# line and silently DROPS an indented or nested block, so a re-flowed value starts the engine
# without a setting this file claims to declare. Keep every value on one line.

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite

# The checkpoint ships its own configuration and modeling modules.
trust-remote-code: true

tp-size: 1

disable-radix-cache: true

chunked-prefill-size: 2048

# LOAD-BEARING, NOT COSMETIC: the checkpoint advertises 163840 positions and the engine sizes a
# device-side int32 req_to_token table of (max requests + 1) x (context length + 4) from this, so
# leaving it at the advertised window costs hundreds of gigabytes and the server never starts.
# The longest request this workload draws is 4000 + 1000 = 5000, so nothing is truncated.
context-length: 32768

random-seed: 42
